args.title: Fix zero-decimal currency parsing and formatting for CLP
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

When parsing amounts for zero-decimal currencies like CLP, do not multiply by 100 or assume a two-decimal format; instead, parse the value directly into minor units without scaling by minorDigits, or adjust the parsing logic so zero-decimal currencies do not lose precision or get divided incorrectly.
